author: jasonwE2063GD

title: Superb tour and brilliant host
text:
What a superb day! We were very fortunate in that we went in November and it was just Caterina and ourselves so was easy to have lots of good conversations.

Her knowledge of Seville and local culture is second to none. 
The experience itself- well she explained every bit of food and drink we had, its heritage and why it was important but also took in to account our personal preferences.

It is something we would both highly recommend and would certainly do again.

Caterina made the day and was a superb tour guide.
author: steb66

title: Wonderful food tour
text: Wonderful food tour! Our guide Christina was amazing — knowledgeable, friendly, energetic, and full of life. You could really tell she loved her job. Every course was delicious, with lots of information and history along the way. Highly recommended!
